prompt_text: Insert {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3} into a hashmap, then look up key "b" and print the value. Expected output: "2".

candidate_responses.text: CARGO-CULT: Map constructor, keys() spread, indexed access — but prints the KEY name "b" instead of the value 2.
